attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: daily_ticket_summary_email
trigger:
  type: schedule
  cron: "0 11 * * 1-5"
  timezone: America/New_York
steps:
  - id: fetch_open_tickets
    op: database.query
    params:
      source: tickets_db
      query: >
        SELECT t.ticket_id, t.subject, t.status, t.priority, t.producer_id,
               t.created_at, t.last_status_update,
               p.full_name AS producer_name, p.email AS producer_email
        FROM tickets t
        JOIN producers p ON t.producer_id = p.producer_id
        WHERE t.status != 'cerrado'
          AND t.archived = false
          AND t.visible = true
        ORDER BY t.producer_id, t.created_at
    output: open_tickets

  - id: group_and_calculate_stale
    op: transform.group_and_enrich
    params:
      input: "{{ open_tickets }}"
      group_by: producer_id
      computed_fields:
        - name: hours_since_update
          expression: "ROUND((NOW() - last_status_update) / 3600, 1)"
        - name: is_stalled
          expression: "hours_since_update > 4"
      include_producer_metadata:
        - producer_name
        - producer_email
    output: grouped_by_producer

  - id: format_summary_emails
    op: template.render
    params:
      input: "{{ grouped_by_producer }}"
      iterate_over: producers
      template: |
        Subject: Daily Open Tickets Summary - {{ current_date }}

        Hello {{ producer.producer_name }},

        Here is your daily summary of open tickets as of {{ current_time }}:

        Total Open Tickets: {{ producer.tickets | length }}
        Stalled Tickets (>4 hrs): {{ producer.tickets | selectattr('is_stalled', 'true') | list | length }}

        {% for ticket in producer.tickets %}
        --------------------------------------------------
        {% if ticket.is_stalled %}⚠️ WARNING: STALLED ({{ ticket.hours_since_update }} hrs without update){% endif %}
        Ticket ID:    {{ ticket.ticket_id }}
        Subject:      {{ ticket.subject }}
        Status:       {{ ticket.status }}
        Priority:     {{ ticket.priority }}
        Created:      {{ ticket.created_at }}
        Last Updated: {{ ticket.last_status_update }}
        Hours Since Update: {{ ticket.hours_since_update }}
        --------------------------------------------------
        {% endfor %}

        Please review and update any stalled tickets at your earliest convenience.

        — Ticket Management System
      output_fields:
        - to
        - subject
        - body
    output: formatted_emails

  - id: send_summary_emails
    op: email.send_batch
    params:
      input: "{{ formatted_emails }}"
      iterate_over: emails
      email:
        to: "{{ email.producer_email }}"
        subject: "{{ email.subject }}"
        body: "{{ email.body }}"
        content_type: text/plain
        from: noreply@brokerage-tickets.com
        reply_to: support@brokerage-tickets.com
      retry:
        max_attempts: 3
        backoff_seconds: 30
    output: send_results
